༄༅/ /dgra mnan gshin rje dmar po rlung gi sgrub pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dgra mnan gshin rje dmar po rlung gi sgrub pa bzhugs so//

ya mān+ta ka la na mo/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal shor sang nyi ma khros pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa la dgra chen po zug pa'am/ bgegs drag pos 'tshe ba'am/ da lta gsod brdung zer ba byung na/ gshin rje kiṃ kaṃ khros pa thugs kyi rlung sgrub 'di nyams su blangs te/ dben pa'i gnas su phung sa sna tshogs la maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i dbus su/ brub khung rgyar khru gang dpangs mtho gang pa/ rgya'i phyed tshad kyi dpangs la'ang rim gsum pa phyi ro sol gyis nag po dang nang gri khrag sogs khrag sna dang snying snas dmar po byugs/ kha khyer la drag po'i rtsang stod smad gri khrag dang btsag gis dmar po dang sked par ro sol gyis nag po byugs pa nyer gcig srin mo'i 'gros su btsugs/ de'i steng du mañji sogs kyi khar lcags snod du 'bru nag las byas pa'i gtor ma bra gzugs sha khrag mtshe yungs rtsang gis brgyan pa/ ong skyu bcad kha phyir bstan ci mang gis bskor ba'i rtse mor bris sku dang*/ gdugs dmar nag gzug /gtor stegs la brub khung steng du g.yag rnga nag po dang*/ gri lcags rtse mo thur du dpyangs pa rten du btags/ sman raka mchod pa thun rdzas la sogs nyer mkho rnams tshogs par bshams/ liṅga bri ba ni/ 'chi sbyor/ bdud nyi/ nyi nag la sogs pa gdug cing rtsub pa/ kiṃ kaṃ zin phung sogs gdug pa rgyu ba'i dus su phyogs der kha phyogs pas/ gdong la ro sol byugs/ kha ru sha chen mur/ lag pa khrag gis sbags la/ shi gos sam dug shog khru gang tsam la mur+dha gang dgos dpe ris ltar la/ spyi bor laṃ nan/ dpral bar rus/ snying gar ming dang bla 'gugs sngags/ brla la bla dwags/ rkang pa la na tri rbad nan/ khar bdud po da longs/ mig la long*/ rna bar 'on/ mgrin par rdzi/ dpung pa gnyis la 'di rna bar bri ba'ang bshad/ yuṃ she/ rkang zhabs su yaṃ/ yan lag bzhi la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram/

byin pa gnyis la gli/ 'doms su phaṭa/ snying gar dzaḥnṛ za/ kha la dung dung*/ dpung par s+t+waṃ bha ya chings shig /tshigs chen bzhi la dzaḥbazhi/ liṅga'i gzhogs g.yas su lo dang zla ba la dgra dar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ g.yon du zhag dang za ma la= mdun du srog lus dbang thang rlung rta la= spyi bor dgra mgo thog tu bab pa ri las lci ba= rkang zhabs su dgra rkang 'og tu tsher las rtsub pa= liṅga'i mgo nas g.yas ngos su yig mgo nang bstan du/ snga dgra lag tu bdar ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ phyi dgra yid la gshom pa= da dgra khyi ltar zug pa= rgyab nas 'ded pa= mdun nas sgug pa= zur nas rku zhing 'phrog pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ bzang dgra gdong nas sdig pa= ngan dgra 'og nas 'jab pa= lus la sbrul ltar 'khril ba thams cad= klad nas rbab ltar 'dril ba= zhabs su dong brko ba= mgo la til rdung byed pa= sems la sdug bsngal gtong ba= lus la na tsha gtong ba= srog la bar gcod gtong ba= rgyab nas khyi ltar 'ded pa thams cad= mdun nas rtsang bzhin du 'dzugs pa thams cad= zur nas gcod dgos zer ba thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ za lam du dug g.yos byed pa= 'gro lam du sgug 'phrog byed pa= lod pa brgya'i mi kha= ngan pa stong gi smra mchu= pho brgya mda' ltar 'phen pa= mo brgya dug g.yos byed pa= byams pa gnyen gyis brjod du ma bcug cig mā ra ya nan brub/ sdang ba dgra yi sgrog tu= mnyan pa'i gru tshugs su gleng du= mgar gyi sol mal du gleng du= dge 'dun gyi tshogs gral du gleng du= sngags pa'i phur gral du gleng du= skyes pa pho brgya'i mda' gral du gleng du= za ma mo brgya'i 'phang gral du gleng du ma bcug cig mā ra ya nan brub/ byis pa chung gsum gyi rtsed gral du= ban gyi chos gral du gleng du= bon gyi zor gral du gleng du= brgya kha mang gi kha zug pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ stong mig mang gi bra mchu ngan pa=

pha tsho'i 'du khang nas mi kha gleng ba= yul mi dang khyim mtshes kyi mi kha zug pa= nye bas nang bslu mtshang 'bru byed pa= khyim mtshes kyis ngan sbyor rku gshom byed pa= gsod gshom byed pa= 'phrog gshom byed pa= ngos la khyi ltar zug pa= lkog nas 'bu bzhin du 'bug pa= skag bdud gshed gsum la bab pa= byad kha dang phur kha zug pa= mnan gtad dang khram du bcug pa= sbyin sreg dang zor kha phog pa = rbad 'dre dang rbod gtong ngan pa= than dang ltas ngan pa= mo dang rmi lam ngan pa thams cad mā ra ya nan brub/ mtshon dug mu ge'i bskal pa ngan pa= lo nyes btsa' sad ser gsum= mi kha dang dgra sna rlung ltar 'tshubs pa= mi kha dang dgra sna me ltar 'bar ba= mi kha dang dgra sna chu ltar 'brub pa= nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra 'dre byur gsum thams cad/ bstan dgra che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum tshe srog lus dbang rlung rta bsod nams dpal 'byor phun tshogs mthu stobs nus pa lha srung dang bcas pa= gzhan yang snang srid lha srin dregs pa sde brgyad kyi za kha ston pa= pho sri/ mo sri/ che sri/ chung sri/ na sri/ dar sri/ gzhon sri/ dur sri/ god sri langs pa shi kha bye ba thams cad mā ra ya rbad nan chings shig /mā ra ya rbad nan sod cig /bskal pa ma stong gi bar du ma gtong zhig /mā ra ya rbad nan sod/ oṃ laṃ/ āḥlaṃ/ hūm̐ lam/ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan chings brub sod/ dgra bgegs sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad sod nan chings brub/ ces pa 'di yan liṅga la 'bri ba dang*/ sgrub pa'i dus sngags kyi mtshams su brjod pa gnyis ka bya'o// de'i phyir liṅga'i mgo nas gzhogs g.yas su/ sngags mgo nang bstan du oṃ ya ma kiṃ kaṃ nas| chings shig gi bar sngags ring gis bskor/ de'i phyir sbrul dkar nag mgo mjug mdud pa bri/ de'i phyir dzaḥnan khram gsum gyis bskor/ de ltar bris zin nas liṅga 'byung bzhis bkrus| khrag sna/ dug sna/

sa sna rnams byug lcags snod du bcer la mgo rang ngos su bstan la bzhag /gser skyems bsham/ rang ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug /kho'i nyes pa bsgrags/ gzu dpang dam bdar bya/ dgug 'dren drag po brgya phrag las mi nyung ba dang*/ kiṃ kaṃ gi bla 'gugs dang*/ khwa khwa mu kha'i lha dbye bya/ bla 'gugs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas bla 'gugs sngags ci 'grub bzlas rjes/ lha dbye'i rdzas kyis bdug /liṅga gshed lteb nṛ mig mthong ba zur gsum yang zlog ltar bltabs la shi yug sngo dmar gyis rgya gram du bcings| brub khung du bcug brub khung kha gcod/ 'og rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ steng ri rab gling bcu gnyis bris pa'i lte bar thun bug pa bkag /thun bug tu gri lcags sam seng ldeng ngam dug shing gi phur pas bkag /de ltar zin nas las gzhung bsrang zhing*/ ngag smra ba bcad nas sgrub pa la 'jug go// bla khug pa'i rtags mthong nas bsad sngags sbrel/ bsad rtags mthong zhing khyad par nang rtags rmi lam du shing chen po sgyel ba'am/ brag dang ri bshig pa'am/ sems can gyi rigs bsad pa/ btson du mi'am dud 'gro bzung ba dang*/ bcings pa dang go rar btsud pa dang*| mgo dang snying dang sha khrag rang la gzhan gyis byin pa sogs mdor na bsad mnan gyi rtags brtan po lan gsum yan chad mthong ba dang*/ liṅga brub khung nas tshur phyung*/ lcags snod du bcer| gser skyems bshams la gzu dpang bya/ dgug gzhug drag po brgya phrag sogs kyi mthar kiṃ kaṃ gi bla 'gugs dang*/ khwa khwa mu kha'i lha dbye bya/ lha dbye dgug gzhug drag po byas rjes yang zlog gi phur gdab gud bkol ltar bya zhing mtshon chas bsgral tshul tsam ma gtogs dngos su mi bsgral/ de rjes ro lteb bya/ pho yin na g.yas kyis g.yon bkab/ mo yin na g.yon gyis g.yas bkab/ de rjes stod nas mar dril/ shi yug gi skras rgya gram du bcings/ zhing lpags sam ro ras kyis dril/

bla ma la bya rgod thod pa/ dge slong la ngang pa'i thod pa/ sngags par bya rog thod pa/ bon por gcan gzan thod pa/ rgyal por mdze thod dam mi dpon thod/ mi skyar phag thod/ bud med la ra thod la sogs par bcug /phung res dril/ sngo dmar ram sna lngas rgya gram du bcings/ rtsang btsugs/ khro zhal gyis rgyas gdab/ lam rgya gram mam/ zam ru'am/ gtsug lag khang gi ma them 'og gam/ dur khrod/ mchod rten gyi 'og gnas 'di rnams su sde brgyad thams cad 'du bar rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud nas gsungs pa yin no// la sogs pa gang du gnon pa'i sar khyer la/ gzhi bdag dang sde brgyad la gtor ma btang*/ rang ma nyes pa'i dpang gzug |kho'i nyes pa bsgrags/ dong tshad man ngag ltar gru gsum du bru/ dbye 'gugs dmigs pa dang bcas pas thod pa'i kha dgra phyogs dang klad khung gnam du bstan la mnan/ steng du dur rdo la 'og rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ steng du ri rab gling bcu gnyis bris pas mnan/ de'i steng sāts+tsha ser po bzhag la don yod grub pa'i pho brang btab par bsam/ de'i steng rlung me chu sa rnams rim bzhin bkab/ dong nang tsher mas bkang*/ de'i steng bal nag gis bkab/ de'i steng sas dam par g.yogs la/ me chu go log gi dmigs pa dang*/ 'dul sbyong gzir mnan gyi bro brdung bya/ nang du log nas srung 'khor dang stong pa nyid bsgom/ de lta bu'i las sbyor ni dgra bo'i za thog dang*/ lo dang*/ zla ba dang*/ zhag dang za ma'i dus skag la bab pa'am/ yang na dgra bo'i lo zla zhag dus kyi bdun zur dang sprad/ gza' skar gdug cing rtsub pa dang*/ gza' dang sa bdag drag po 'gyu ba'i dus la bab pa dang las sbyor bya/ sa rko ba'i dus lto 'phye'i kha lta phyogs brtag par bya/ de ltar lag len gnad ma 'chug par zhag bdun bsgrub na lo gsum tshun chad la dgra med par thag chod/ bdun gnyis bsgrub na lo drug tshun la dgra mi 'ong*/

bdun gsum bsgrub na lo dgu tshun chad la dgra mi 'ong bar thag chod/ srog la byed na zla ba gcig tshang ba bsgrub/ gang la'ang bla khug pa dang*/ bsad pa dang*/ mnan pa dang*/ bcings pa'i nang rtags nges pa can lan gsum re yan chad gsal por 'byung ba gal che ba yin/ de 'jam dpal gshin rje khros pa thugs kyi sgrub pa gshin rje dmar chung rlung sgrub tu grags pa 'di la bka' gter gnyis su yod pa/ bka' ma ni pa la pa tra'i rgyud nas slob dpon de wa tsan+d+ras bsdus pa shor sang nyi ma khros pa rgyas par zhal gsum/ phyag drug /yum dang bcas pa/ las sbyor 'khor lo sogs rgyas par gsungs pa dang*/ de nyid bsdus pa nag chung dang dmar chung gnyis kar zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ yum dang 'khor med pa/ las sbyor ling rkyang kho na la brten pa gsungs pa dang*/ gter ma pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi gshin rje kha la rgyas 'debs dang*/ dum pa rgya zhang khrom gyi gshin rje dmar chung gi rlung sgrub sogs mang du gter kha so sor yod pa rnams yin la/ de thams cad lag len dang las byang sogs khrigs chags med par 'thor ba zhig 'dug pa/ dus mtha'i sngags 'chang rig 'dzin thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu 'bri gung pa gnam lcags me 'bar gyi phyag len rnams/ bu lod rin chen bzang pos phyag bris su btab 'dug pa rnams phyogs gcig tu gong 'og lag len go rim star chags su/ 'bri gung pa sngags 'chang chos kyi grags pa zhes sam/ thugs kyi rdo rje zhes bya bas rang gi brjed byang dang bstan pa bsrung ba'i lag char rang lo zhe dgu pa chu lug dbo zla'i dkar po'i rgyal ba gsum pa dus dge ba'i char/ sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog pho brang chen po rtse ba gzhis kar bris pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa la rnam par 'tshe ba thams cad tshar gcod pa'i srung ma dam par gyur cig gu// //maṅga laṃ//
